findings.reason: Untrusted source: 'meta' points into the AF_XDP UMEM TX-metadata area (set by __xsk_buff_get_metadata() at xdp_sock_drv.h:312-325 as data - pool->tx_metadata_len), memory that unprivileged userspace maps and can write concurrently while NAPI TX runs; no lock or snapshot protects it. Double fetch: xsk_buff_valid_tx_metadata() (lines 262-272) READ_ONCE-caches only meta->flags and validates the flag values plus pool->tx_metadata_len against offsetofend(request.launch_time), but xsk_tx_metadata_request() then re-dereferences the same shared struct per field: meta->flags at 294/299/303/307 is re-read instead of using the validated snapshot held in *flags (which is never passed into this function), and meta->request.csum_start/csum_offset at 304-305 plus meta->request.launch_time at 295 are fetched a second time from shared memory with no READ_ONCE and no local cache. The validated value and the consumed value can differ under a concurrent userspace write between the two fetches, exactly the seed's check-then-use mechanism on the same struct xsk_tx_metadata. Consumed by: every zero-copy driver TX path - mlx5 (en/xsk/tx.c:102 then en/xdp.c:508/656 via mlx5e_xsk_tx_metadata_ops), igc (igc_main.c:3077,3085), stmmac (stmmac_main.c:2722,2751), libeth/idpf (include/net/libeth/xsk.h:208). Counterevidence checked: no current .tmo_request_checksum implementation consumes the values for memory access - mlx5e_xsk_request_checksum (mlx5 en/xdp.c:298-304) and libeth_xsktmo_req_csum (include/net/libeth/xsk.h:167-171) ignore both arguments and only set a CSUM flag; igc and stmmac register no checksum op; igc/stmmac launch_time handlers use the racy u64 only as a time value. So the invariant violation (validated-equals-used broken: validated flags snapshot discarded, fields independently re-fetched from user-writable memory and handed to driver callbacks) is verified in source, but no current in-tree consumer turns the second fetch into an out-of-bounds access, hence low confidence; the csum_start/csum_offset arguments remain an unvalidated-value contract per include/net/xdp_sock.h:107-110 that any offset-consuming implementation would inherit.

candidates.reason: Seed's own fixed function xsk_skb_metadata() at lines 964-1005: csum_start/csum_offset READ_ONCE'd into locals at 980-981, same locals used for the bounds check (983) and skb assignment (987-988); flags READ_ONCE-cached once at 966 and the cached copy gates every use; launch_time read once at 1001. Invariant holds; also explicitly not reportable.

xskq_cons_read_desc() copies the whole user-mapped xdp_desc struct by value into the local '*desc' (line 257) before xskq_cons_is_valid_desc() validates it (line 258); downstream TX consumers (xsk_build_skb, igc/stmmac/mlx5/libeth) use only the local copy and never re-dereference the ring entry. Single-fetch snapshot by value.
xskq_cons_read_desc_batch() copies ring->desc[idx] into descs[nb_entries] (line 294) once and parse_desc() validates that same copy; no second read of the ring entry.

__xp_alloc() fill-ring consumer: xskq_cons_peek_addr_unchecked() reads the u64 addr once into a local (xsk_queue.h:136-152), xp_check_aligned/unaligned validate and normalize that same local (xsk_buff_pool.c:520-535), xp_get_xskb() uses the validated local; addr is never re-read from the ring.

__xsk_buff_get_metadata() validates via xsk_buff_valid_tx_metadata() which caches only flags and checks pool->tx_metadata_len; the meta pointer is derived from the validated tx_metadata_len and desc addr, and only the pointer is passed on; the field-level double fetch is in xsk_tx_metadata_request() and is reported as the finding.

mlx5e_xsk_request_checksum() takes csum_start/csum_offset but ignores both ('HW/FW is doing parsing, so offsets are largely ignored'), only setting eseg->cs_flags |= MLX5_ETH_WQE_L3_CSUM|L4_CSUM; no offset/length arithmetic on the racy values.
libeth_xsktmo_req_csum() documents csum_start/csum_offset as @unused and only sets LIBETH_XDP_TX_CSUM; idpf/libeth TX path consumes no racy value as offset or length.

igc_xdp_xmit_zc() calls xsk_buff_get_metadata() then xsk_tx_metadata_request() at 3085; igc_xsk_request_launch_time() (2993) consumes the racy launch_time u64 through ns_to_ktime()/igc_tx_launchtime() and advances ring->next_to_use via insert_empty_frame plus used_desc budget accounting; no memory-safety violation demonstrated (caller clamps by budget >= 4 and desc_unused), but the consumed value is demonstrably not the one whose enabling flags were validated.

stmmac_xdp_xmit_zc() calls xsk_tx_metadata_request() with stmmac ops; stmmac_xsk_request_launch_time() (2661) converts the racy launch_time via ns_to_timespec64() into stmmac_set_desc_tbs() sec/nsec descriptor fields; no demonstrated OOB, but the value is a second uncached fetch from user-writable UMEM.

mlx5e_xsk_tx() calls xsk_buff_get_metadata(pool, desc.addr) at 102 and passes meta through mlx5e_xmit_xdp_frame (en/xdp.c:508) and the mpwqe path (656) into xsk_tx_metadata_request(); mlx5 ops ignore the racy csum values (see mlx5 candidate) so no OOB, but the pointer and its re-reads flow through two indirect-call layers; the mpwqe completion path was not exhaustively audited.

xsk_tx_metadata_to_compl()/xsk_tx_metadata_complete() caches only the &meta->completion.tx_timestamp pointer and writes the HW timestamp u64 through it at completion; the write lands at a fixed struct offset in the user's own buffer per the documented API - no user-controlled offset or length is consumed.

limitations: The reported include/net/xdp_sock_drv.h double fetch is mechanism-verified (validated flags snapshot discarded, csum_start/csum_offset/launch_time re-read from UMEM without READ_ONCE) but no current in-tree .tmo_request_checksum consumer uses the values as a memory offset, so no out-of-bounds impact was demonstrated in s03; impact rests on the documented ops contract (include/net/xdp_sock.h:107-110) and on any driver implementing offset-consuming checksum offload.

igc launch_time (igc_main.c:2993) and stmmac launch_time (stmmac_main.c:2661) consume the racy u64 in scheduling/descriptor arithmetic; no obvious OOB found, but igc_tx_launchtime()/igc_insert_empty_frame() and stmmac_set_desc_tbs() internals were not fully audited for derived index math.

Search bounded to the xsk/AF_XDP branch: net/xdp/*, include/net/xdp_sock*.h, include/net/xsk_buff_pool.h, include/net/libeth/xsk.h, and every in-tree caller of xsk_buff_get_metadata/xsk_buff_raw_get_ctx/xsk_tx_metadata_request (igc, stmmac, mlx5, libeth/idpf); vhost/virtio, af_packet TPACKET, and io_uring branches are covered by other intents.
No compilation or runtime reproducer was built; conclusions are from source reading only.
